H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H8398: the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H3245: to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult
H5104: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H7723: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H7650: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H1875: properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H8179: an opening, i.e. door or gate
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H6607: an opening (literally), i.e. door (gate) or entrance way
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5808: forcible; collectively and concretely, an army
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
